primary_comparators.note: this set is exactly the set audited in Stage 4A. Nothing was added or removed during validation.

cdbw.implementation: paper-faithful correction layer over PyPI cdbw==0.2 (MIT), whose geometry is reused with attribution

aggregations_corrected.C1_stdev: average standard deviation over the considered clusters (the package returns the highest-indexed one)
aggregations_corrected.C2_separation_distance: for each cluster, the minimum distance over ALL other clusters (the package minimises over lower-indexed clusters only)
aggregations_corrected.C3_inter_density: mean over clusters of each maximum pairwise inter-density (the package uses a single global maximum divided by K)

cdbw.label_order_policy_note: none is required: the corrected index is permutation-invariant by construction. Labels are made contiguous only so the reused helpers can index by label, and that is provably neutral.
cdbw.why_the_correction_exists: the reference package is not invariant to cluster naming; the spread over orderings reaches 0.93 absolute and can change which candidate partition scores best

invalid_when.cdbw_cluster_with_single_representative: a cluster has one representative, so the shrunk-representative construction is undefined; the package silently returns 0 here
invalid_when.cdbw_no_mutual_representative_pair: a cluster pair has no mutually closest representatives
invalid_when.cdbw_non_finite_density: the density terms are not finite

cvnn.implementation: independent Python implementation; CRAN fpc::cvnn used as oracle only (no GPL source incorporated)
cvnn.set_relative_note: the separation and compactness terms are normalised across the compared candidate set, so a CVNN value is meaningful only within a fixed candidate bank; fixed32 provides that bank. K=1 candidates are INCLUDED in the normalisers, as in fpc.

cvdd.implementation: port under MIT licence with attribution (hulianyu/CVDD)
cvdd.frozen_applicability_rule: if X contains two or more EXACTLY identical rows, CVDD is INVALID with reason CVDD_DUPLICATE_POINT_MST_AMBIGUITY
cvdd.why_the_rule_exists: the density-involved distance rests on a minimax path distance from a minimum spanning tree; exact duplicates create zero-weight edges, the MST is then non-unique, and the published procedure defines no implementation-independent tie-break
cvdd.rule_scope: invalidates CVDD ONLY -- never the dataset, view, another CVI, a method run, or fixed32 candidate generation

dcsi.implementation: independent Python implementation from arXiv:2310.12806v4 (CC BY 4.0); the author repository declares no licence and is used as an oracle only

frozen_parameters.epsilon_rule: per-class median distance to the (2*MinPts)-th within-class nearest neighbour

edge_case_semantics.any_undefined_pair: INVALID(dcsi_pair_undefined:<reason>) for the whole partition -- the paper aggregates over ALL K(K-1)/2 pairs, so a mean over the survivors is a different estimand and the paper is silent on substituting it
edge_case_semantics.duplicate_observations: permitted -- DCSI uses only the MAXIMUM MST edge, which is identical across all minimum spanning trees even when the MST is non-unique
edge_case_semantics.noise_label: label -1 is excluded from the class set; it is not a class in the paper's sense
edge_case_semantics.class_smaller_than_2_MinPts_plus_1: the largest available within-class neighbour distance is used as the continuous extension, and this is documented rather than silently imputed

dcsi_author_compat.definition: Sep = 2 x the paper separation, reproducing the author's multiclass routine calc_DCSI_RW
dcsi_author_compat.role: AUTHOR-IMPLEMENTATION-COMPATIBILITY diagnostic and predeclared sensitivity variant
excluded_from: the primary comparator set and its count
dcsi_author_compat.permitted_use: reported only in the predeclared DCSI sensitivity analysis and in implementation-provenance discussion
dcsi_author_compat.ranking_caveat: dcsi and dcsi_author_compat are NOT interchangeable rankers. They agree for K=2 and can disagree for K>=3; see validation/dcsi_variant_ranking_evidence.json

cdbw_package_compat.definition: the raw PyPI cdbw 0.2 value under a canonical centroid-lexicographic cluster ordering
cdbw_package_compat.why_an_ordering_is_imposed: the raw package has no single value for a partition without one; the ordering exists solely to make this diagnostic reproducible
excluded_from: the primary comparator set and its count
cdbw_package_compat.permitted_use: implementation-provenance discussion and sensitivity reporting only

shared_rules.invalidity_is_explicit: every comparator returns either a finite value or an explicit INVALID with a reason; no comparator silently substitutes a default
shared_rules.invalidity_is_metric_local: an INVALID comparator never invalidates the dataset, the view, another CVI, a method run, or candidate generation
shared_rules.no_edge_behaviour_flattening: published indices legitimately differ on noise, singletons and degenerate partitions; their edge behaviour is not harmonised, because that would misrepresent them

diagnostic_variants_are_never_comparator: dcsi_author_compat and cdbw_package_compat are diagnostics. Neither adds a primary comparator; the primary set stays at exactly four.
